dialogues.speaker: Hrovoje
dialogues.text: It's not safe around these parts — you should get some insurance. Better safe than sorry, 'ey!

dialogues.speaker: Hrovoje
dialogues.text: I'm the proprietor of this 'ere rest stop — the only safe place fer miles around. Whether you're after a break from the road or looking to replenish your supplies, you'd do well not to pass us by. Oh, and we sell insurance.

dialogues.speaker: Hrovoje
dialogues.text: This is a cursed place. There was the shipwreck a few years ago, and more recently, merchants 'ave been getting attacked, then there's that Nothing Passage...

dialogues.speaker: Hrovoje
dialogues.text: A little while back, I spotted a whole bunch of northerners... Fatui, they was. They dragged all sorts of 'eavy equipment inside. And then what? Who knows — not one of 'em's come out.

dialogues.speaker: Hrovoje
dialogues.text: Anyway, it's extremely dangerous. Even an adventurer like you should be wary.

dialogues.speaker: Hrovoje
dialogues.text: It works like this — you give me a bunch of Mora fer a "policy," and then if, or when, the unthinkable 'appens  — within the confines of this 'ere specified region, naturally — I'll pay out ten times the Mora to your designated beneficiary. 'ow about it?

dialogues.speaker: Hrovoje
dialogues.text: *sigh* Suit yourself, but mind you don't run into anything unthinkable!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't think I'll need it.

dialogues.speaker: Hrovoje
dialogues.text: *sigh* Young people always think it won't 'appen to them.
